sanctions.title: Crypto Address Sanctions Screening | OFAC SDN Batch Check
sanctions.description: Screen 1–100 public crypto addresses for exact matches in the daily OFAC SDN snapshot. Export JSON with source timestamps and match flags. EVM matching ignores case; other formats preserve case. A non-match is not clearance or compliance certification.
sanctions.seoTitle: Crypto Address Sanctions Screening | OFAC SDN Batch Check
sanctions.seoDescription: Batch-check crypto addresses against the daily OFAC SDN snapshot. JSON match flags and source timestamps; exact matches, not compliance clearance.
sanctions.example_scope: Illustrative public/synthetic input, not a payment, verified address or live result. Replace with own public input; never add internal self-test flags.
